QUESTION:
What does the `--max-parallel` flag of `pq tenant describe` do?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0508] cli | pq tenant describe | version 4.x
# `pq tenant describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a tenant.

## Usage
```
pq tenant describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--priority` | Priority from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest). Default: 4. |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would happen without changing anything. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |

## Example
```
pq tenant describe orders --priority
```

---

[d0348] cli | pq tenant list | version 4.x
# `pq tenant list`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Lists tenants.

## Usage
```
pq tenant list <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |

## Example
```
pq tenant list orders --tenant
```

---

[d0134] cli | pq dlq describe | version 4.x
# `pq dlq describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a dlq.

## Usage
```
pq dlq describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--label` | Attach a `key=value` label. Can be repeated. |
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |

## Example
```
pq dlq describe orders --tenant
```

---

[d0059] cli | pq tenant move | version 4.x
# `pq tenant move`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Moves a tenant.

## Usage
```
pq tenant move <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--output` | Output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`. Default: `table`. |

## Example
```
pq tenant move orders --wait
```

---

[d0717] cli | pq snapshot resume | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot resume`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Resumes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot resume <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot resume orders --tenant
```

response.content: `--max-parallel` sets the maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Its default is `2`.
